description: This file defines a SwiftUI widget named OpenClawLiveActivity, using ActivityKit to display real-time status information for the OpenClaw application, including dynamic island regions and lock screen views with status indicators.

methods.name: lockScreenView
methods.description: Creates the lock screen view displaying the status dot and relevant information based on the activity context.

methods.name: trailingView
methods.description: Generates a view showing connection status or a timer based on the activity's content state.

methods.name: statusDot
methods.description: Returns a colored dot representing the current status of the activity state.

methods.name: dotColor
methods.description: Determines the color of the status dot based on activity connection state.
